name: Pastis
editorial_article: David Álvarez Tudela, better known as Pastis, rose to prominence as a central figure in the Barcelona mákina scene during the early 1990s. He began his deejaying career in 1992 and eventually gained widespread recognition as a resident DJ at the famous club Xque. Throughout his career, he collaborated extensively with David Pàmies Sabatés as the duo Pastis & Buenri, releasing tracks on labels such as DJ's At Work, Uptempo, and Xque Records. Their influence on the Spanish rave circuit culminated in high-profile media appearances, including a notable performance on the TVE1 program Música Sí in the early 2000s alongside DJ Skudero and Xavi Metralla. Pastis is often credited with holding a significant stake in the popularity of the bakalao sound in Catalonia during the peak of its club culture.
editorial_bio: Spanish DJ and producer David Álvarez Tudela was a foundational architect of the 1990s Barcelona mákina and hard trance scene.
